versions.content: destinationUriNestingContract is set to targetCon- tainer When the destinationUriNestingContract is set to targetCon- tainer the EcucContainerDef in the role container qualifies as the target con- tainer of EcucUriReferenceDef . The according EcucContainerDef shall have the identical shortName and at least the defined subContainers, references and pa- rameters with the given attributes (e.g shortName , range and multiplicity).
